title: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2610.32285v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used to solve real-world problems, and their effectiveness depends on both the underlying models and the harnesses that support their operation. However, most existing benchmarks focus on model capabilities and overall agent performance, with limited attention to the evaluation of agent harnesses. To address this gap, we introduce TraceTrial-Bench, which organizes harness reliability into seven components covering context, execution, governance, lifecycle, observability, tools, and verification. We construct 95 expert-level, mechanism-oriented tasks with executable or state-based ground truth to support semantically equivalent comparisons while preserving the native behavior of each harness. We design a Trajectory Tracing (TT) module to capture agent execution traces and introduce a two-layer evaluation framework that separately assesses agent performance and harness reliability. translated_title: 轨迹审判：面向可靠性与失败归因的AI智能体框架基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体（LLM agents）越来越多地被用于解决现实世界的问题，其有效性既取决于底层模型，也取决于支持其运行的框架。然而，现有的大多数基准测试主要关注模型能力和智能体的整体性能，对智能体框架的评估关注有限。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了TraceTrial-Bench，该基准将框架可靠性划分为七个组成部分，涵盖上下文、执行、治理、生命周期、可观测性、工具和验证。我们构建了95个专家级、面向机制的任务，并配有可执行或基于状态的基准真值，以支持语义等价的比较，同时保留每个框架的原生行为。我们设计了轨迹追踪（Trajectory Tracing, TT）模块来捕获智能体的执行轨迹，并引入了一个双层评估框架，分别评估智能体性能和框架可靠性。此外，我们还设计了一个多……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出TraceTrial-Bench基准，通过七大可靠性组件、95个专家级机制导向任务、轨迹追踪模块和双层评估框架，首次系统性地实现对AI智能体框架的可靠性与失败归因评估。
en_tdlr: We introduce TraceTrial-Bench, featuring seven reliability components, 95 expert-level mechanism-oriented tasks, a Trajectory Tracing module, and a two-layer evaluation framework, enabling systematic benchmarking of AI agent harnesses for reliability and failure attribution.
